text: Timing: 30 seconds. Introduce Nogor Shomadhan as a civic complaint platform connecting residents, administrators, and community authorities. State that the demonstration follows one complaint through its complete life cycle.
Notifications keep the resident and authority informed at each material status change.
textPreview: Notifications keep the resident and authority informed at each material status change.

text: Timing: 50 seconds. Explain the handoff between roles. Emphasize that AI assists classification and duplicate detection, while the admin makes the final review decision. The authority owns execution and evidence. The resident sees the full history and submits feedback.
Sign in with a verified resident account.

text: Timing: 45 seconds. Show the four status cards and recent complaints. Mention the navigation tabs once, then move directly to the complaint form. Authentication is demonstrated only if the evaluator asks.
Open Complaints and select New Complaint.

text: Timing: 70 seconds. Enter only enough data to demonstrate the required fields. Use a prepared photo to avoid camera delay. After submission, explain that classification and duplicate checking run automatically.
AI selects one complaint category from the system list.
textPreview: AI selects one complaint category from the system list.

text: It compares recent reports in the same category.
textPreview: It compares recent reports in the same category.

text: Location and the real-world issue carry more weight than wording.
textPreview: Location and the real-world issue carry more weight than wording.

text: A score of 80% or higher creates an admin warning.
textPreview: A score of 80% or higher creates an admin warning.

text: Admin compares both reports and makes the final decision.
textPreview: Admin compares both reports and makes the final decision.

text: Accept as duplicate removes the newly submitted copy. Reject as duplicate keeps it as a separate complaint.
textPreview: Accept as duplicate removes the newly submitted copy. Reject as duplicate keeps it as a separate complaint.

text: Stored confidence: 98.5%. The screen rounds it to 99%.
textPreview: Stored confidence: 98.5%. The screen rounds it to 99%.

text: Timing: 60 seconds. Explain that the AI does not delete complaints. It produces a confidence score and reason. The admin retains control. In the live dataset, the road-hole reports show a 98.5 percent match.
Open Review Complaints from the admin dashboard.
